text:
alex: FYI alert: env-sync watermark breach between prod and staging at ~10:11 UTC. Autoscaler fell back to on-demand, about 3 extra GPU nodes spun up. Cost spike estimated ~\u00248k/day. Anyone oncall?

infra-bot: [ALERT] env-sync-checker: prod->staging diff=+47 resources; watermark=0.82 threshold=0.75; auto-fallback triggered. See https://internal.redwood/alerts/ENV-SYNC-1234 :rotating_light:

maria: on it, pinging @jonathan and @tanvi. Did gitops operator fail to apply something?

jonathan: gitops operator logged a policy block: `policy/zz-helm-immutable`. The helm release didn't apply the values that would have kept `autoscaler.max` lower. So reconcile loop fell back to provisioning via fallback provisioner.

maria: which commit caused this?

jonathan: commit ab12cd3 bumped the GPU nodepool desired count and changed helm values. The terraform apply didn't succeed in CI because the cloud quota was exceeded, so the gitops operator treated it as non-fatal and the fallback path created on-demand nodes.

alex: can you paste the operator logs?

jonathan: logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:11:34Z gitops-operator: apply failed: policy check blocked: "zz-helm-immutable"
2026-03-17T10:11:35Z reconcile: helm apply skipped, marking release as pending
2026-03-17T10:11:35Z autoscaler: desired=48 actual=32 -> scaling decision: fallback to provisioner
2026-03-17T10:12:01Z provisioner: create nodepools: eu-west-3-gpu-fallback -> launched 3 p3.xlarge
2026-03-17T10:12:05Z cost-annotator: estimated delta = $8200/day
```

tanvi: checking cloud quota dashboard now. CI showed `quotaExceeded` for `nvidia-gpu` in eu-west-3: requested 50, available 40. The problematic bit is that our reconcile controller currently treats provider errors as warnings, so it continued with fallback instead of failing fast.

maria: action plan proposal:
1) pause auto-fallback immediately so we don't keep creating expensive on-demand nodes.
2) revert the helm values in infra repo to previous `autoscaler.max`.
3) open ticket to request quota increase or adjust nodepool sizing across regions.
4) add a CI preflight check to fail pipeline if `terraform plan` emits provider quota errors.

alex: I can pause fallback. Command: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap/auto-fallback -p '{"data":{"enabled":"false"}}'`

jonathan: rolling back helm via `git revert ab12cd3` now and opening PR to rerun plan after coordination with cloud quota. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/234

infra-bot: Deploy created: infra/reconciler -> canary, triggered preflight checks.

maria: +1 to adding a stricter plan parser. Right now `terraform plan` warnings from provider are swallowed by the plan runner. We should treat any `quotaExceeded` or provider errors as pipeline failures.

tanvi: I'll add a sentinel in the plan parser and a unit test to capture an example `quotaExceeded` payload. Will also add a metric so env-sync-checker alerts earlier (before fallback triggers).

sre-runbook: note for incident writeup: cost alerts should escalate when `auto-fallback` is enabled AND `env-sync` diff > threshold. We didn't page correctly.

alex: cost alert fired but escalation policy didn't trigger. I'll fix the alerting rule to escalate to oncall if `auto-fallback` is true.

maria: for immediate cleanup, once the new nodes are provisioned and helm rollback is applied, we should manually drain/delete the 3 fallback nodes. Use cloud console or `gcloud compute instances delete` for those instances.

jonathan: deleting the fallback instances now: `gcloud compute instances delete eu-west-3-gpu-fallback-*-p3 --zone=eu-west-3a`

jonathan: deleted 3 nodes, cluster stabilized, pod evictions resolved, metrics returning to baseline. Cost projection back to normal.

alex: thanks all. Follow-ups:
- maria to write a short postmortem with timeline + PR links.
- tanvi to add plan parser sentinel + env-sync early warning metric.
- jonathan to update gitops operator to fail reconcile on provider quota errors instead of taking fallback path.
- alex to update alert escalation for cost/fallback combo.

maria: I'll draft the postmortem and link PRs in the ticket.

tanvi: I'll include a test that simulates `quotaExceeded` in our CI fixtures.

infra-bot: Incident closed by alex at 10:56 UTC.
